{{URL|https://www.hitachiaircon.com/}} }} '''Johnson Controls Hitachi AC Limited''' is a Japanese [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[air conditioning]] manufacturing company that manufactures [[home appliance]]s and specialises in air conditioning and [[Cooling|cooling technology]]. The company was incorporated on 1 October 2015 in Tokyo, as a Joint Venture between [[Johnson Controls]] and [[Hitachi|Hitachi Appliances]]. The Chief Executive Officer of the company is Shoji Akiyama.{{Cite web|title=Our Leadership|url=https://www.jci-hitachi.com/about/leadership/|website=Johnson Controls-Hitachi}} The shares of its major subsidiary in India are traded on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] under symbol JCHAC. == Acquisition == In July 2024, Johnson Controls said it would sell its residential and light commercial buildings business to [[Bosch (company)|Bosch]] for $6.7 billion. As part of the deal, Bosch will acquire 100% of the Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning joint venture, including Hitachi’s 40% stake. Johnson Controls will continue selling York and Coleman products, while the Hitachi brand will remain in Asia under a long-term license with [[Bosch Home Comfort Group]].{{Cite web|title=Questions and Answers|url=https://www.bosch-homecomfortgroup.com/en/news-and-stories/news/question-and-answers/|website=Bosch Home Comfort Group|access-date=2024-08-07}} == India == In India, Hitachi air conditioners are manufactured and marketed by Hitachi Home & Life Solutions India Ltd, which is a joint venture between [[Hitachi]] Homes and the Johnson Controls group based in Ireland. The company is headquartered in Ahmadabad, Gujarat. It has another Global Development Center in Kadi, Gujarat.{{Cite web|title=Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning opens Global Development Center in India|url=https://www.jci-hitachi.com/news/1420.html|website=Johnson Controls-Hitachi}} == Gallery == {{Gallery|width=180| File:Johnson Controls Hitachi RnD Centre.jpg|Johnson Controls Hitachi R&D Centre in India|File:Split Hitachi 2.jpg|Hitachi Indoor Unit|File:Motore condizionatore Hitachi 3.jpg|Hitachi Outdoor Unit}} == References == {{reflist}} {{Hitachi|state=expanded}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Hitachi subsidiaries]] [[Category:Johnson Controls]] [[Category:Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning companies]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Joint ventures]]
